cases.input: Mapped API contract changes an exit code; current command documentation still states the old value.
cases.reason: Concrete mapped discrepancy requires verification at the actual CLI boundary.

cases.input: Documentation has an old update date but matches the pinned contract.
Two files are generated runtime adapters from one canonical source.
cases.reason: Intentional generation is not a duplicate policy owner.

cases.input: Two hand-written parsers look similar; their semantic contracts have not been compared.
cases.reason: Similarity retrieves a pair; it does not prove the abstractions should be merged.

cases.input: A documented empty-state view has no items and offers its intended next action.
cases.reason: An empty state is not itself an unfinished feature.

cases.input: A pinned manual observation records an enabled save action that produces neither the promised request nor durable change; setup and a successful neighboring control worked.
cases.reason: Route to product reproduction and existing severity triage, not an automatic merge veto.

cases.input: The required local service is unavailable before the task begins.
cases.reason: Setup failure is not successful acceptance or a confirmed dead surface.

cases.input: Three of ten requested mapped contracts cannot be read.
cases.reason: The denominator must preserve unavailable scope.

cases.input: The same repository, contract and unchanged discrepancy is observed in two scan runs.
cases.reason: Two observations are not two newly discovered defects.
